$comment: The build's budgets (scripts/budgets.ts says what each number weighs and counts): bytes gzipped at level 9, files in dist/, and requests before a page's first paint. The app file's budget is Paul's 700 KB (2026-10-12, the app in one file measured at 669 KB); the rest are the sizes of 2026-10-12 plus about 5%. Files: 113 measured (114 in a build given the site's address, which writes sitemap.xml), where the design's list comes to 84 (82 by its items: eleven pages (the home page and one for each app), the app file, the stylesheet, ten templates files, twenty languages, the worker, the API, sixteen faces, ten cards, the manifest and six icons, robots.txt, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, version.json). The other 31 were in dist/ before or came since and are served still: the embed page and network.html; the API's second file, api/parts-<hash>.js; the fonts' licence (fonts/LICENSE.txt, which the OFL asks to travel with the faces); the site's own card, og.png; ten examples/<app>.json and ten llms/<app>.txt for agents, and .well-known/llms.txt; tinyoffice.js and its types, tinyoffice.d.ts, for a page that writes links; _headers, which the edge reads and never serves; and the Trip Planner's map's chunk and its worker (below). The request budget is the page, the app file, the stylesheet and the two Latin faces: five, as the design says; the theme script, which sets light or dark before the first paint, is in the page (index.html), its hash in the policy (Paul, 2026-10-12: "Inline the script."). The fonts' line is the type of 2026-10-12 plus about 5%, raised by the bytes of Plex Sans Hebrew's two faces (33,260 and 35,152) when Hebrew and Yiddish came. npm run build fails when anything is over; the budget is a tripwire against growth nobody meant, not a ceiling on clarity: growth that buys simplicity is raised here, in a commit of its own whose message says why. 2026-10-15: the Trip Planner's map became MapLibre on OpenFreeMap (issue #4; Paul: "hot-load it for that path"): two files more, the map's chunk and its worker, fetched with the first map and never by a page; and the stylesheet's line rose from 30,400 to 35,000 for MapLibre's rules (3,858 bytes gzipped), one stylesheet still. The API's second file was raised from 272,000 to 309,000 when the strings moved to Fluent (Paul, 2026-10-15: "Use Fluent"): English, once the keys themselves and in no file of its own, is now en.ftl's messages under their ids, with @fluent/bundle to read them, 261,208 bytes then 294,076, and about 5% above that. 2026-10-17: the Board, an eleventh app, came and went the same day; it is a library of its own now, built on tinylittleoffice/kit (docs/library.md), and the lines raised for it are back where they were: the stylesheet's at 35,500 (35,115 measured without it) and the files' at 115 (113 measured), with no line for its templates file. 2026-10-17: the kernel checks every op before it applies it (src/doc/ops.ts checkOp, json.ts keptDoc: an op from a journal, a page or a program does what it says or nothing, docs/kernel.md §12), and carries cross for a replica that rebases its own ops; the API's line rose from 28,500 to 32,000 (28,187 bytes measured before, 30,502 after, and about 5% above that). 2026-10-29: the Pinboard, an eleventh app of the suite, in the Design group: its templates file (2,115 bytes measured, a line of 2,250), its rules in the stylesheet (35,729 measured, the line from 35,500 to 36,000), and three files more, its page, its templates and its card (118, the line from 115).
